civic_before.title: Naga City Civic Center grounds
civic_before.credit: Naga City Civic Center — Owner-supplied overhead reference (Google Maps), capture date unknown; draft geographic estimates. Geometry: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

sources.title: OpenStreetMap: site and surrounding features
sources.note: ODbL. Site and building footprints, mapped monuments and facilities. No OSM edit dates are interpreted as construction dates.

sources.title: Independent facility reference
sources.note: Official facilities description supports sports grounds and mapped museum/skate/tennis facilities. Museo forecourt, mapped monuments and national flagpole are retained. Mapped pool water and the existing draft rim/deck are retained. Existing OSM trees are not duplicated. All added positions, counts, widths and heights are schematic estimates fitted to OSM, not surveyed geometry. The later owner-supplied overhead reference supersedes the earlier unregistered placement. No timeline dates are inferred.

sources.title: Owner-supplied overhead reference, five-site adjustment
sources.note: Inspected supplied image; registered to cached OSM roof/pool outlines. Capture and imagery dates unknown. Positions, sizes and counts are estimates; no construction dates inferred. Reference bitmap remains ignored evidence and is not distributed. Mapped footprints are preserved, including alignment uncertainty.

sources.title: Owner correction: restrained Civic Center canopy
sources.note: Latest owner ASCII view shows excessive coverage. Crown diameters reduced about 45 percent; redundant estimated trunks thinned with 11-metre spacing. All mapped tree ids/positions/heights, pool, courts, museum and monuments retained. Earlier dense foliage masks are superseded; dimensions remain draft.
